label: Guard the driver status history and reject new reservations for an inactive driver (#82)

precheck.description: driver, driverReservation and route tables exist
precheck.sql: SELECT to_regclass('public.driver') IS NOT NULL AND to_regclass('public."driverReservation"') IS NOT NULL AND to_regclass('public.route') IS NOT NULL AS result

execute.sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.driver_status_change_immutable() RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path = pg_catalog, public AS $$
BEGIN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Driver status history is append-only' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
END $$
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS driver_status_change_immutable ON public."driverStatusChange"

CREATE TRIGGER driver_status_change_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON public."driverStatusChange"
FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.driver_status_change_immutable()

execute.description: a new reservation or route assignment requires an active driver; FOR SHARE serializes against a concurrent deactivation, which updates the same row and waits for this transaction

execute.sql: DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS driver_reservation_requires_active_driver ON public."driverReservation"

CREATE TRIGGER driver_reservation_requires_active_driver BEFORE INSERT ON public."driverReservation"
FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.driver_requires_active_for_assignment()
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS route_requires_active_driver ON public.route

CREATE TRIGGER route_requires_active_driver BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF "driverId" ON public.route
FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.driver_requires_active_for_assignment()

postcheck.description: the three guard triggers are installed and enabled

              AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgname='route_requires_active_driver' AND tgenabled='O' AND tgrelid='public.route'::regclass)
            ) AS result
